check_directory_existence.name: check_directory_existence
check_directory_existence.summary:
Checks if the specified directory exists.

    This tool performs a preliminary existence check and validates system-level access permissions.

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: The path to the directory to be checked.

traverse_the_directory.name: traverse_the_directory
traverse_the_directory.summary:
Traverses and lists all contents in the specified directory.

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: The path to the directory to be traversed.
